Dev (PM): Quick brainstorm: we need a concise "egress escrow" & blackout pricing pattern for Private Deploy docs. Goal: one-pager sales can paste + a short ops-runbook.
Sam (Eng Ops): "Egress escrow" = we reserve a customer's egress IP block in our infra for a tenant. That needs an IP escrow form + confirmation of routeability from customer.
Priya (Legal): Legal note: any IP reservation becomes binding only when signed into the SOW for Enterprise. For lower tiers we can say 'reserved on request, best-effort'.
Jo (Sales): Field signal: customers will pay for deterministic blackout windows around billing closes. They prefer a monthly reserved slot (predictable) over per-event expensive holds.
Arjun (Infra): Ops point: monthly slots are trivially schedulable (we block maintenance windows). Per-event holds require on-call staffing and may delay other rollouts. Need to include an "operational surcharge" line.
Dev (PM): I like two productized add-ons: "egress-escrow" (monthly) and "no-upgrade voucher" (monthly or single-use). Keep pricing flexible.
Sam (Eng Ops): Operational checklist we should include in the doc: 1) customer provides IP block + ASN (if required) 2) named network contact 3) escalation path 4) expected rollback delta for pinned lanes.
Jo (Sales): Can we offer a hybrid: escrow + soft-preserve for managed tier? E.g., reserved but not contractual unless Enterprise. Gives sales flexibility.
Priya (Legal): Yes. Recommended language: "Reserved egress IPs are advisory for Managed tier and contractually reserved for Enterprise when listed in SOW." Short and pasteable.
Arjun (Infra): Add runbook snippet for ops (short): ```
# egress escrow runbook
1. verify customer IP allocation and L3 reachability
2. reserve IP block in infra inventory
3. annotate tenant with escrow expiration
4. schedule blackout window (if purchased)
5. run upgrade with monitor and rollback hooks
```
Sam (Eng Ops): Also include a perf tradeoff note: pinned versions and escrowed IPs can increase snapshot storage and KV churn. Put a line: "expect +10-25% storage overhead and possible +30-90m rollback delta depending on model KV size."
Dev (PM): Good. For pricing copy: Jo, can you draft two paste-ready lines: one for Managed+escrow (monthly) and one for Enterprise (contracted)?
Jo (Sales): Will do. Tentative: "Managed + Egress Escrow: monthly fee, reserved IP while active, best-effort blackout slot per month." "Enterprise: contractual egress reservation and negotiated blackout SLAs."
Priya (Legal): Add SOW pre-req: "Customer must provide documented IP allocation and network contact prior to reservation taking effect."
Arjun (Infra): Implementation note: we need an inventory field in the operator UI for escrowed IPs and a flag to block upgrades for tenants with active "no-upgrade voucher". Small UI work.
Sam (Eng Ops): Suggest adding a short YAML example to docs so field engineers can recommend configs quickly:
```yaml
install_preset: managed-escrow
egress_escrow: true
egress_block: 203.0.113.0/28
network_contact: ops@cust.example
no_upgrade_voucher: monthly
```
Dev (PM): Action items: Jo -> paste-ready sales lines + pilot pricing (Thu). Arjun -> operator UI ticket for 'egress escrow' & 'no-upgrade flag' (Mon). Sam -> ops-runbook + storage/rollback numbers (Tue). Priya -> SOW snippet (Wed). I'll assemble one-pager after inputs.
